schedule.extended_period_policy: Use Period 6 only when no other slot is available

rules.description: No student may have two courses scheduled in the same time slot
A teacher cannot teach multiple courses simultaneously in the same time slot
Teachers cannot be scheduled in slots already published in other campuses or cohorts
No classes during lunch break (12:30 to 13:30)
Lab blocks must be exactly 2 consecutive periods on the same day (valid: P1+P2, P2+P3, P4+P5, P5+P6 only; never cross lunch)
Assign exactly the required theory and practical hours per course (no more, no less)
Use Period 6 only as a last resort
Spread theory hours across different days of the week (avoid multiple theory sessions on the same day)
Single-department courses are preferred in the morning (P1, P2, P3); cross-department courses preferred in afternoon (P4, P5)
Corresponding MDC, VAC, SEC and AEC papers must occupy identical periods across all departments. Different paper positions, including AEC 1 and AEC 2, use separate campus blocks.
AEC courses (3 hours) must be scheduled strictly on Tuesdays and/or Wednesdays during afternoon periods (P4, P5, P6) campus-wide
Common campus AEC first paper KU01AECENG101: Tuesday 13:30-16:30 (P4-P6)
Common campus AEC second paper KU01AECENG102: Wednesday 13:30-16:30 (P4-P6)
MDC courses have 3 theory hours and no practicals, split into a 2-hour continuous session on one day and a 1-hour session on another day
All VAC courses (2 hours) must be scheduled strictly on Mondays during Periods 5 and 6 (P5+P6) campus-wide

hard_constraints: No student may have two courses scheduled in the same time slot
No classes during lunch break (12:30 to 13:30)
Lab blocks must be exactly 2 consecutive periods on the same day (valid: P1+P2, P2+P3, P4+P5, P5+P6 only; never cross lunch)
Assign exactly the required theory and practical hours per course (no more, no less)
Use Period 6 only as a last resort
Parallel electives for a batch must occupy identical time slots for the full block duration (never pair 1-hour theory with half of a 2-hour lab)
Corresponding MDC, VAC, SEC and AEC papers share identical periods campus-wide; distinct paper positions retain separate blocks
Category-pure parallelization: Only parallelize courses belonging to the exact same category. Never mix multiple categories (e.g. never combine MDC with VAC, SEC, AEC, or DSC in parallel slots)
soft_constraints: Single-department courses are preferred in the morning (P1, P2, P3)

Spread theory hours across different days of the week (avoid multiple theory sessions on the same day)
